dedupe_keys.name: 10 m staple crop map of nepal 2021 2023 sentinel 2

description: This dataset is a national 10 m map of staple crops in Nepal for 2021, 2022 and 2023, from the paper "National-scale mapping of staple crops in Nepal with multi-year Sentinel-2 L2A imagery and binary transformer models" (International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation). The Zenodo record says pixels are coded as staple crops, other crops, non-crop or uncertain, and that results are given per Sentinel-2 tile (Nepal spans 28 tiles) and as combined GeoTIFFs, with accuracy assessment files. Version v1 was published on 24 March 2026 by Dong Luo, with files of about 110 to 140 MB each, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0, with national coverage. Caveats: which crops count as staple is defined in the paper, not on the page read, and hill terraces make small fields hard to map. For simulation it gives staple crop areas for flood, landslide and drought exposure, and for food supply scenarios when roads in the hills are cut. Related catalogue records include the ACIA500 cropping intensity for monsoon Asia and the Unified Cropland Layer.
name: 10 m staple crop map of Nepal, 2021-2023 (Sentinel-2)
